lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4Mn2 (reduced formula Ce2Mn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 121), with six atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 11 geometric neighbors (8 Ce, 3 Mn) and Mn centers with 8 Ce neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face contacts between Ce and Mn coordination polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing among Ce polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all six sites.
